title: On Time
content: I can't decide whether time is the thing that moves, or whether we do. If we are moving through it, then everything that has happened is still sitting somewhere behind us. If it is moving through us, then we are just standing in the river, being slowly worn away.

title: On Color
content: The universe probably doesn't look like anything. Color is an interface our brain renders so we can navigate electromagnetic radiation. To a rock, the universe is blind.

title: On Cinema
content: Why can a three-minute scene in a film stay with you for years? It's the only medium that mimics the structure of memory—images and sound disconnected from their original context, replaying in the dark.
